summary: v0.14.1-beta tested: Guide pages (all roles, filtering, tabs, index scroll, step animation, FAQ accordion, single/all HTML download, offline rendering, 390px responsive) all PASS. GridFS storage for documenti/annunci/ricevute PASS (upload, download, restore after local file deleted, delete removes both local + allegati.files). /api/version = 0.14.1-beta. ONE BUG: GDPR export ZIP (and /gdpr/my-data) returns 0 rimborsi and no allegati due to ObjectId vs string user_id mismatch (pre-existing, but explicitly requested to verify).

critical.issue: Queries db.rimborsi.find({'user_id': ObjectId(...)}) but rimborsi store user_id as STRING (rimborsi.py:133) -> 0 rimborsi exported, ZIP contains only dati.json + README.txt, no allegati. Also file collection uses rc['filename'] (original user-supplied name, e.g. 'scontrino.pdf') instead of rc['path'] (stored UUID key), and checks r['contabile_filename'] while contabile is stored as r['contabile'] = {filename, path}. Fix: query {'user_id': user['id']} (or $in both forms), collect rc['path'] and r['contabile']['path'], arcname may use original filename.
Same ObjectId vs string user_id mismatch -> rimborsi always empty in art.15 access response.

minor.issue: get_local_path/save_upload do not validate the key (no basename / path traversal guard). Currently keys are server-generated, but if GDPR fix keeps using user-supplied rc['filename'] it becomes a path-traversal read. Add Path(name).name == name check.
Uses blocking path.read_bytes() inside async startup task; fine for small sets but blocks the event loop on large uploads dir.

Stale assertions in older test files (version pins 0.11-0.14.0, legal doc version '1.0' now '1.3', register payload missing privacy_accepted/termini_accepted, rate-limit tests sensitive to prior state). Not app regressions.

issues: Steps (li) start at opacity:0 and rely on JS IntersectionObserver; if JS is disabled (e.g. some mail/preview viewers) steps stay invisible. Consider <noscript><style>li{opacity:1;transform:none}</style></noscript>.

action_items: Fix GDPR export-zip & my-data: match rimborsi.user_id as string, include ricevute via rc['path'] and contabile via r['contabile']['path']
Add basename guard in core/storage.py for keys
Optional: noscript fallback for offline guide steps
Optional: update stale version/legal-version assertions in older test files
critical_code_review_comments: Guide role filtering is client-side only: the 'Dettagli tecnici' / 'Limiti noti' sections (infra: Tailscale SSH, Cloudflare Tunnel, missing inactivity logout, no email alerts) ship in the JS bundle to every user incl. iscritti. Low-risk info disclosure; consider serving admin-only guide content from an authenticated API or removing sensitive infra details.
GridFS put_binary does not dedupe: re-saving the same key creates duplicate files (get by name returns latest; delete removes all) - acceptable but note.
get_local_path writes restored file non-atomically; concurrent downloads of a missing file may race (minor).

success_rate.backend: 83% (5/6 new tests; only GDPR export fails)

rca of the issue: GDPR export: rimborsi.create stores user_id=user['id'] (str) while gdpr.py queries ObjectId(user['id']) -> no match. Repro: create rimborso as superadmin, upload ricevuta, GET /api/gdpr/export-zip -> dati.json rimborsi=[] and no ricevute/ entries. Mitigation: query with string id and use stored 'path' keys.
